items.title: Billkin heads to Milan for Gucci's 'The Store Show'
items.summary: Harper's Bazaar Thailand reports Thai brand ambassador Billkin (Putthipong Assaratanakul) departed for Milan Fashion Week to attend Gucci's 'The Store Show', styled by Gucci in a logo top, denim and a Jackie Flap bag for the airport departure look. Reflects continued high-profile deployment of Gucci's Thai ambassador for global brand visibility.

items.title: Gucci official X account features Billkin en route to Milan store show
items.summary: Gucci's own X account posted airport photos of Thai ambassador Billkin traveling to Milan for the brand's store show, prompting Thai entertainment press coverage. Brand-controlled activation content amplifying a SEA ambassador on a global stage; counted as official-brand tier per policy.

items.title: Gucci officially features Billkin heading to Milan
items.summary: Japanese-language Thai-entertainment outlet covers Gucci's official promotion of ambassador Billkin ahead of the Milan store show, describing his airport styling as understated yet striking. Secondary regional pickup of the same event, confirming cross-market fan interest beyond Thailand.

items.source: Tripadvisor (Shoppes at Marina Bay Sands reviews)
items.title: "Very BAD welcome and ZERO service" — Gucci Marina Bay Sands review
items.summary: A visitor review of the Gucci boutique at The Shoppes at Marina Bay Sands, Singapore, describes a poor in-store welcome and lack of attentive service despite the flagship's recent two-floor renovation. Direct critical-angle consumer sentiment on Gucci's SEA flagship retail experience, distinct from marketing coverage of the store's makeover.

items.title: PurseForum thread splits on Gucci build quality under Demna
items.summary: Long-running PurseForum thread shows divided sentiment: some collectors report continued satisfaction with Gucci leather quality, while other posters criticize newer coated-canvas and print-nylon pieces as prioritizing logo visibility over craftsmanship, and describe a flagship store visit as feeling cheap. Balances the positive ambassador-driven news flow with grassroots product-quality skepticism.

items.title: Analysts flag Gucci's September exit rate as key turnaround signal ahead of Q3
items.summary: Trade press analysis (via Finimize/WWD commentary) notes Kering management expects roughly flat group growth in Q3 2026, with Gucci's September run-rate viewed by analysts as the critical data point for judging whether the turnaround under Demna is taking hold; Asia-Pacific has lagged the US recovery, with the region down mid-single digits earlier in the year. Provides business-performance context for reading SEA retail sentiment against the group's still-fragile recovery narrative.

items.title: Street-interview TikToks ask "is Gucci overrated?"
items.summary: Recurring TikTok street-interview format videos poll passersby on whether Gucci is an overrated fashion brand, with commenters recycling the recurring critique that heavy logo saturation and mass availability have eroded exclusivity. General-audience SNS content (not SEA-geo-tagged specifically) but representative of the wider critical online discourse the region's audience also engages with; retained as one of the only accessible SNS-critical threads surfaced today.
